scope: Actual source identity, component topology, metal resistor effective R and metal external-coupling first moment with all other conductors clamped. Excludes intrinsic device/MIM loading and finite driver resistance. Not qualified PEX, bandwidth, a new transient, or changed acceptance. Shared comparator nets use an explicitly labeled canonical terminal reference, not a unique driver. Effective R and clamped-metal first moments do not include nonlinear loading or imply full settling/signoff.
